name: [SHADOW] Aimfox AutoConnect import · Supabase branch S

parameters.query:
-- The key comes from client_sequencers, not a spreadsheet cell (defect 7 of branch L). It is used
-- to call the vendor and MUST NOT reach the audit row.
select c.id::text                as client_id,
       c.name                    as client_name,
       cs.api_key                as api_key,
       cs.external_workspace_id  as workspace_id
  from public.clients c
  join public.client_sequencers cs on cs.client_id = c.id
  join public.sequencers s on s.id = cs.sequencer_id and s.key = 'aimfox'
 where cs.enabled
   and cs.api_key is not null and cs.api_key <> ''
   and c.status in ('Active', 'Onboarding', 'Subscription')
   and ($1 = '' or c.id = nullif($1, '')::uuid)
 order by c.name;

-- `linkedin_invitation_sent_at is null` is a local idempotency key branch L never had (defect 5):
-- it re-reads yesterday every run and re-POSTs the batch. The column exists and nothing writes it
-- today, so branch S can own it once it starts sending.
-- The window is a real timestamptz range, not a string compared as M/d/yyyy (defect 3).
select l.id::text        as lead_id,
       l.client_id::text as client_id,
       l.linkedin_url    as linkedin_url
  from public.leads l
 where l.client_id in (select (jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb))::uuid)
   and l.linkedin_url is not null and l.linkedin_url <> ''
   and l.linkedin_invitation_sent_at is null
   and l.created_at >= $2::timestamptz
   and l.created_at <  $3::timestamptz
 order by l.client_id, l.created_at;

-- Branch L records nothing at all (defect 6), which is how a nightly job imported for nobody for
-- months without anyone noticing. A shadow that is not recorded is not a measurement.
insert into public.integration_sync_runs
  (provider, sync_type, n8n_execution_id, status, started_at, finished_at, metadata)
values ('aimfox', $4, $1, $2, now(), now(), $3::jsonb)
on conflict (n8n_execution_id) do nothing
returning id::text as run_id;
